column7: SAML ACS and OIDC callback sessions record clientIP(r), not r.RemoteAddr (fixed in #2919): behind a trusted proxy the forwarded client address is recorded; an X-Forwarded-For from an untrusted peer is ignored (TestCompleteSAML_SessionIgnoresForwardedHeaderFromUntrustedPeer, same file). The no-raw-RemoteAddr class guard is TestLoginHandlers_NeverPassRawRemoteAddrToALoginCall, and the canonical-IP pins are TestCompleteSAML_SessionRecordsCanonicalClientIP and TestCompleteSSO_SessionRecordsCanonicalClientIP (sso_session_client_ip_test.go).
